title: Reachability after one additional step
statement: Let $K,L,t$ be natural numbers, let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $I$ be a predicate on the natural numbers. A vertex $t$ is reachable in at most $L+1$ steps from some $I$-vertex below $K$ if and only if it is reachable in at most $L$ steps, or there is a vertex $w$ reachable in at most $L$ steps such that $R(w,t)$ and $t<K$.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a binary relation on the natural numbers
$I$ is a predicate on the natural numbers
